About this product

The Ubiquiti UniFi Switch Pro 8 PoE USW-Pro-8-PoE is a compact Layer 3 managed switch for small to medium-sized networks. It features eight Gigabit Ethernet ports, with six supporting PoE+ (up to 30W) and two supporting PoE++ (up to 60W), backed by a 120W total PoE budget. Two 10G SFP+ ports provide high-speed fibre uplinks. With a 56 Gbps switching capacity and 28 Gbps non-blocking throughput, it handles data efficiently.
